Discover the beloved world of the record-breaking, multi-million-copy bestselling series where power always demands a price, secrets darken every hallway, and death is only ever a heartbeat away.

'Yarros is the true inheritor of Harry Potter and inspires Hunger Games levels of devotion' Guardian

.

THIRTEEN UNFORGETTABLE STORIES
ONE LEGENDARY DAY.
THERE IS ONLY ONE RULE . . . DON'T DIE.

Threshing Day features unforgettable stories from thirteen characters and their dragons, including:

Xaden Riorson and Sgaeyl
Brennan Sorrengail and Marbh
Sloane Mairi and Thoirt
Sawyer Henrick and Sliseag
Imogen Cardulo and Glane
Ridoc Gamlyn and Aotrom
Garrick Tavis and Chradh
Aaric Graycastle and Molvic
Mira Sorrengail and Teine
Liam Mairi and Deigh
Bodhi Durran and Cuir and more! Full blurb to come.

This ebook edition includes sixteen original black-and-white illustrations by artist Joe Requeza.

DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES TO BOND A DRAGON?

COMING SOON IN THE EMPYREAN WORLD:

THRESHING DAY (LIMITED DELUXE EDITION): Our limited deluxe hardback includes silver-gilded edges and sixteen full-colour illustrations by artist Joe Requeza and silver-gilded edges. Coming September 29th 2026.

FOURTH WING, THE GRAPHIC NOVEL: VOLUME ONE: The first volume of a stunning graphic novel adapted by Rebecca Yarros. Coming April 6th 2027.

FOURTH WING, TAROT DECK: 78 tarot cards with familiar characters, scenes, and symbols from the Empyrean series. Coming April 6th 2027.

A MAJOR TV ADAPTION: Fourth Wing has now been greenlit at MGM Amazon Studios with Michael B. Jordan's Outlier Society - don't be the last to discover the magic of this blockbuster series.
